newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks see-sawed before ending down on profit-taking on Sunday, a day after sectarian clashes in Lahore, dealers said.
One dealer said the Karachi 100-share index was likely to open mixed on Monday's clearing day due to profit-taking.

The index slipped 2.42 points, or 0.18 percent, to 1,360.48 by the close amid 116 losers and 116 gainers. It had risen about five points on short-covering in morning trade, but closed lower on profit-taking sparked by the Lahore trouble, a dealer said.
